source_text.Q-1037: GH #2364: PollerTest REQ-218 AC3 spinning-antagonist partial-skip test is probabilistic and flaked twice on CI (main run 37716503527 EPYC 9V74; PR #2374 run 37723710619 shard 2/3 EPYC 7763). Make it deterministic, test-only.

task.description: Replace the spinning-antagonist AC3 test (REQ-218) in test/letflow/scheduler/poller_test.exs with a deterministic test: the test process holds the sole global admission unit before a tick and a telemetry handler releases it on the 4th rejected poll_and_fire decision.
acceptance_criteria: Rejected timers stay due and fire next tick

result.summary: Implemented in commit b52e5792 (test-only, no lib/ change): test process holds the sole global unit, telemetry handler on admission_decision releases it on the 4th rejected poll_and_fire decision; asserts rejected prefix/admitted rest, rejected timers pending, all 10 fired on second tick.
